Runs on Solarpunk 1.3.0: players join with the game's own invite code.

## Server

### Added
- `"Transport": "eos"` in the `Solarpunk` section of `appsettings.json`. The host keeps the game's own Epic Online Services network driver instead of swapping in `IpNetDriver`, so players join with the invite code the game shows, with nothing else installed. Leave it out (or set `"ip"`) for the old direct-IP join.

### Why
- Solarpunk 1.3.0 moved multiplayer onto Epic Online Services. The game now signs in to Epic before it opens a world, and an Epic host refuses direct-IP clients that do not carry an Epic id (`incompatible_unique_net_id`).
- A host with no Steam client signs in with Epic's anonymous device login. Put these lines in the instance's `Saved\Config\Windows\Engine.ini`:

```
[EpicOnlineServices]
AuthenticationGraph=Anonymous

[OnlineSubsystem]
NativePlatformService=RedpointEOS
```

- The join password (name-channel gate) cannot apply to invite-code players. Leave `SolarpunkAuthPassword` empty in this mode; the invite code is the way in.

Based on v0.1.89 (the default build). The v0.1.90 changes are not in this release.
